prerequisites: Knowledge of the contents developed in the Analog Electronics course.

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with basic digital electronics skills, with particular reference to fundamental circuits (inverters, elementary logic gates), the main analysis and design techniques for digital, combinational and sequential circuits, and semiconductor memories.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to digital electronics: noise margins, propagation times, dissipated power.
Costs and yield of an integrated circuit.
CMOS combinational circuits: complementary CMOS logic, ratioed logic, pass transistor logic, dynamic circuits, Domino logic, np-CMOS logic.
CMOS sequential circuits: latches, registers, flip-flops, bistable, monostable and astable multivibrators.
assessment_rules: The exam consists of an oral test. Questions will cover all course topics. To pass the exam, the student must demonstrate knowledge of the fundamental concepts of analysis of the main combinational and sequential blocks of a digital system and their circuit implementation in CMOS technology.
bibliography: Jan M. Rabaey, Anantha Chandrakasan, Bora Nikolic - Circuiti integrati digitali. L'ottica del progettista, Cester A. (cur.) Gerosa A. (cur.), 2a Edizione, Pearson, 2020
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Biomedica (Electronics And Biomedical Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
